name: codebase-memory-mcp
description: High-performance code intelligence MCP server. Indexes codebases into a persistent knowledge graph — average repo in milliseconds. 158 languages, sub-ms queries, 99% fewer tokens. Single static binary, zero dependencies.
one_liner: A tool that reads a company's entire codebase once and turns it into a fast lookup index, so an AI coding assistant can find what it needs instantly instead of re-reading thousands of files every time — cutting the AI's usage bill.
buyer: An engineering lead at a company running AI coding agents across a large codebase who is watching their monthly AI API bill climb because agents keep re-reading the same files for context.
business_use_cases: An engineering team indexes a large monorepo once so every developer's coding agent gets instant, cheap context instead of expensive repeated file reads.
A dev tools vendor bundles it into their AI coding product to cut their own inference costs while answering 'where is X used' questions faster.
A consultancy auditing a client's inherited codebase uses the generated knowledge graph to quickly map function and service dependencies.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a managed/hosted version with a dashboard for teams that don't want to run and maintain the indexer themselves.
Sell 'cut your AI coding-agent token bill' consulting engagements that install and tune this for a client's repo.

steal_this: It's a free, install-and-run binary — the sellable weekend project is a managed-hosting or dashboard layer on top, not reselling the tool itself.
